## Prerequisites

This workshop assumes you have:

- Access to Sagehen HPC cluster (or equivalent SLURM-based system)
- An SSH client installed on your local machine
- Basic Linux command-line experience
- A text editor of your choice

## Getting Access

If you don't have an account on Sagehen:

1. Contact its-hpc@pomona.edu
2. Include your department and research advisor
3. Wait for account activation (1-2 business days)

## Connecting to Sagehen

From your local machine:

```bash
ssh <myusername>@sagehen.pomona.edu
```

## Creating Your Working Directory

On Sagehen:

```bash
mkdir -p ~/parallel-computing-workshop
cd ~/parallel-computing-workshop
```

## Required Software

Already installed on Sagehen:

- Python 3.9+ with NumPy, SciPy
- R 4.0+ with parallel package
- SLURM job scheduler
- mpi4py for MPI support
- GCC compiler

Verify:

```bash
python3 --version
R --version
sinfo
```

## SLURM Commands to Test

```bash
sinfo          # Show cluster status
squeue -u $USER  # Show your jobs
```

## Text Editor Options

- nano (simplest)
- vim (powerful)
- VS Code with remote SSH extension

## Example: Create Your First Job Script

```bash
cat > ~/parallel-computing-workshop/hello.sh << 'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=hello
#SBATCH --time=00:01:00
#SBATCH --ntasks=1
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=1
#SBATCH --mem=1G

echo "Hello from Sagehen!"
hostname
date
SCRIPT
```

Submit it:

```bash
sbatch hello.sh
squeue -u $USER
```

## Getting Help

- SLURM help: man sbatch
- HPC support: its-hpc@pomona.edu

Ready to go!
